To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) The performance of the parallel matrix factorization algorithms is highly dependent on the matrix sparsity, and the performance of our parallel algorithm is superior to that of the sequential one when the matrix is sufficiently sparse.
• The GPU is a very good platform for matrix factorization.
• We propose a parallel matrix factorization algorithm that exploits the massive parallelism of GPUs to achieve high throughput and low latency.

the following two questions:
